llc.formation_notes: Fee waiver available when a majority of initial membership interests are held by veterans. Expedited service available for extra fees (not verified).

annual_report.name: Annual Statement
annual_report.due: February 15, starting the year after formation (LLCs formed after September 30 skip the first February 15)
annual_report.late_penalty: Not in good standing; restoration fee $50 plus $25 per missing statement

sources.title: CSCL/CD-700 Articles of Organization (rev. 07/25)
sources.quote: NONREFUNDABLE FEE: Make remittance payable to the State of Michigan. ... $50.00

sources.title: LARA Corporations Division FAQ
sources.quote: Every LLC and PLLC is required to file an annual statement starting the year after formation.

sources.title: LARA FAQ - restoring good standing
sources.quote: Restoration Fee: $50 Annual Statement Fee: $25 per missing year

entity_level_taxes.name: Corporate Income Tax (CIT) - S corps generally not subject
entity_level_taxes.notes: Michigan CIT (6%) applies to C corporations; S corporations are treated as flow-through entities. Not re-verified on an official page today.

pte_elective_tax.rate_note: Elective Flow-Through Entity (FTE) tax at the same rate as the individual income tax (4.25% for 2026). Not read on a 2026 Treasury FTE page today (pages 404).

sources.title: Treasury: 2026 individual income tax rate
sources.quote: the individual income tax rate for the 2026 tax year will remain at 4.25%.

income_tax_2026.surtaxes: None at state level; city income taxes in 24 cities (see local_taxes).

sources.title: Treasury news release 2026-04-15
sources.quote: the individual income tax rate for the 2026 tax year will remain at 4.25%.

sources.title: Form 446, 2026 Michigan Income Tax Withholding Guide

estimated_tax.required_if: expect to owe more than $500 on the MI-1040 (rule from MI-1040ES; 2026 form not read)

unemployment_2026.notes: $9,000 for qualified employers ($9,500 otherwise). New employer base rate 2.7% plus a share of the chargeable benefits component (not a single official 2026 figure found); construction uses industry average.

local_taxes.name: City of Detroit income tax (administered by Michigan Treasury)
local_taxes.applies: residents on all income incl. net business/self-employment profits; nonresidents 1.2% on Detroit-source income; corporations pay Detroit corporate income tax separately
local_taxes.quote: The City of Detroit income tax rate for residents is 2.4% (multiply by 0.024). The City of Detroit income tax rate for nonresidents is 1.2%

local_taxes.name: City income tax
local_taxes.applies: residents; nonresidents 0.75% on Grand Rapids-source income (incl. business net profits)
local_taxes.quote: Grand Rapids ... Resident Rate 1.50% Non-Resident Rate 0.75%

local_taxes.name: City income tax
local_taxes.quote: Highland Park ... Resident Rate 2.00% Non-Resident Rate 1.00%

local_taxes.place: Albion, Battle Creek, Benton Harbor, Big Rapids, East Lansing, Flint, Grayling, Hamtramck, Hudson, Ionia, Jackson, Lansing, Lapeer, Muskegon, Muskegon Heights, Pontiac, Port Huron, Portland, Springfield, Walker
local_taxes.name: City income tax (Uniform City Income Tax Ordinance rates)
local_taxes.applies: residents 1.00%; nonresidents 0.50% on city-source income, incl. net profits of a business in the city
local_taxes.threshold_or_exemption: per-exemption amount $600 in most cities; Battle Creek, Springfield, Benton Harbor $750; Ionia $700; Hudson, Portland $1,000; Grayling $3,000 (Grand Rapids table)

notable: 24 cities levy an income tax; Detroit residents pay 2.4% (nonresidents 1.2%) on top of the 4.25% state rate (https://www.michigan.gov/taxes/-/media/Project/Websites/taxes/Forms/City-Withholding/TY2026/5469_ty2026.pdf)
State rate stays at 4.25% for 2026: the automatic rate-cut trigger was not met (https://www.michigan.gov/treasury/news/2026/04/15/state-individual-income-tax-rate-for-2026-tax-year-determined)
Cheap LLC: $50 to form, $25 annual statement due February 15 (https://www.michigan.gov/lara/-/media/Project/Websites/lara/cscl/NonImages_new/Corps/forms/llc/700-0725.pdf)
uncertain: Saginaw city rate: the Grand Rapids official table lists 1.00%/0.50%, but other (secondary and older legislative) sources give 1.5%/0.75%; rate set to null.
Other city rates come from the City of Grand Rapids' table of other Michigan cities (official municipal page, not each city's own site); exemption amounts vary by city.
Elective FTE tax 2026 rate assumed equal to the 4.25% individual rate (statutory link); Treasury FTE pages returned 404.
MI-1040ES 2026 not read; $500 threshold taken from prior-year form wording.
New employer UI rate for 2026 not stated on an official page (2.7% base plus CBC share).
Annual statement late penalty other than loss of good standing not verified; a future reduction of the $25 fee reported by third parties not verified.
